title: Dream of infiltrating the Order of the Broken Cross apocalyptic cult
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Dream of infiltrating the Order of the Broken Cross apocalyptic cult, about unspecified at Jerusalem (dream), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: have a dream about the Order of the Broken Cross, which is this apocalyptic cult in Jerusalem.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes a dream told by Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former senior official at the CIA, the US spy agency. In the dream, Mowatt-Larssen infiltrates the Order of the Broken Cross, which Michels describes as an apocalyptic cult in Jerusalem. It comes up in an episode about Mowatt-Larssen saying he has experienced something like time travel.
